product.name: Automate Bidding & Analysis
product.description: Create templates and sequences to automatically invite vendors, follow up, and analyze their bids.

product.name: Digitize Contracts & Terms
product.description: Store and manage contract terms digitally to avoid missing cancellations.

product.name: Centralize Vendor Management
product.description: Consolidate all key vendor information and performance metrics in one place.

product.name: Strategic Sourcing
product.description: Use historic performance and spend data to find the best vendors and uncover savings.

product.name: Smart Databasing
product.description: Systematically pull all spend, vendor, and contract data from sourcing events into Procoto databases.

product.name: Data Transformation
product.description: Collect and organize all sourcing, vendor, and contract data during onboarding.
